about: IPMA's daily forecast for each of its 35 places, by place and day, as issued: each entry of a series is one version of that day's forecast, with the first and last of our reads that carried it and IPMA's file time. v: [tMin (°C), tMax (°C), probability of precipitation (%), wind class, prevailing wind direction, weather type, precipitation class]. 'nearest_station' is ours: the reporting station closest to the place's coordinates, with the distance, for reading the forecast beside what was observed (observed-daily.json); IPMA does not say which station, if any, a place's forecast stands for. A forecast by IPMA, shown as IPMA's.
label: fact: IPMA's values, reshaped by us; computed fields say so
note: one file per place was read (forecast/meteorology/cities/daily/<globalIdLocal>.json); their hashes are in latest.json
